# Toto Finance

> Toto Finance is the global infrastructure for tokenized commodities, enabling asset-backed digital ownership of metals, energy, and gems.

## About

Toto Finance AG is a Liechtenstein-regulated platform for institutional-grade tokenization of real-world assets. We enable compliant digital ownership with instant settlement and real-world redemption.

## What We Do

- Tokenize physical commodities (gold, silver, platinum, diamonds)
- Enable 24/7 trading of asset-backed tokens
- Provide T+0 settlement
- Offer real-world redemption of physical assets
